title: Legible, continuous pedestrian path from footpath and parking to entries
text: A legible, well-defined, continuous path of travel is provided from the public footpath and car parking areas to building access areas such as lobbies, stairs, accessways and individual dwelling entries.

replaces.note: mixed-use separation of residential and non-residential access dropped (not in the table of changes)

notes: diverges: from ch3 C3.7.10, which is a judgment record. This chapter's fact vocabulary provides parking.path_of_travel_to_entries for C3.7.10, so the clause is recorded as a yes/no the applicant states (continuous path from the public footpath and car parking to lobbies, stairs, accessways and dwelling entries). Whether it is 'legible, well-defined' remains for the planner on review.

verified.note: Wording confirmed (printed without a closing full stop). Yes/no encoding; 'legible, well-defined' remains for the planner.
